name: BEASTMASTER
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Better to have beasts that let themselves be killed than men who run away.”
overview: You are a domineering animal tamer who commands creatures to do your bidding. You have a vast toolkit, with a menagerie at your disposal and the ability to take charge of almost any beast you encounter on-mission, though you are largely helpless without them.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to ensure there are some workable animals available — pets, steeds, and vermin as well as proper wildlife. While ferocious and versatile, your creatures are not infallible machines, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could create heavily-armored or intimidating enemies that can ward off a bestial assault.
grounding: Grounded in tropes surrounding animal handlers training beasts for show or combat, especially (but not solely) those of a more autocratic bent.
examples_heading: Examples from history and pop culture include:
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Beastmaster besides Vitality, Sensory, and Skill? Consider Spirit, Might, or Reflex!
Be sure you are comfortable managing Companions before playing this Class!

abilities.name: Sic ‘Em!
abilities.description: Prompt one or more beasts under your control to fearlessly attack a target, dashing a Low distance at incredible speed to do so.
abilities.paired_action: Indicate your target and give a signal to strike.

notes.text: If the target remains undefeated after a Low Duration, this Ability’s Cooldown is prolonged to Mid, and affected beasts become demoralized while this Ability is on Cooldown.
May target a single beast not under the user’s control to compel it to abruptly lash out at whoever is nearest to it (without dashing), whether an ally to it or not.

abilities.name: Collar
abilities.description: Conjure a magical ring around the neck of a beast to dominate its mind, compelling it to understand and comply with your commands.
abilities.paired_action: Call a cowed or awed animal to heel alongside an assertive gesture.

notes.text: Duration, collar durability, and compulsion all scale on how intimidated and/or impressed the beast is (by the user or otherwise) as this Ability is activated.
If the beast is powerful or willful enough to resist the user’s commands, this Ability ends prematurely.

children.text: Also ends prematurely if the collar is destroyed, which enemies will instinctively know.

notes.text: Cooldown begins on use rather than on expiry, allowing multiple instances to be active at once.

abilities.name: Lure Sigil
abilities.description: Mark a spot to draw a Pitched raging beast to that location.
abilities.paired_action: Touch the surface of a terrain feature while Pitching the chosen beast.

notes.text: A glowing, stylised depiction of that beast appears where touched.

Pitched beast must be appropriate to the locale. It arrives after a delay, scaling on the plausibility of that creature actually being present nearby. (e.g. A tyrannosaurus in a forest overrun with dinosaurs would have a Low delay; a sperm whale in overhunted waters would have a Mid delay; a dragon in a kingdom where they have been extinct for generations would have a High delay.)

children.text: The beast will always arrive enraged.

gear.name: Fearsome Visage
gear.description: Heavy, elaborate masked headdress.

notes.text: Others are more inclined to perceive the owner as dominant while they are behaving accordingly.
The owner appears physically larger to others, scaling on how afraid a given observer is.
Lets the owner use the Witchfinder Ability Omoriori solely to sense and locate fear (Mid Cooldown)

gear.name: Bullwhip
gear.description: Exceptionally long lash.

notes.text: Each whipcrack may issue up to a 5-word command to any number of chosen allies who hear it.

gear.name: Offcuts
gear.description: Chunks of bone-in meat.

notes.text: Feed one to an interested animal to Hearten it with Low Boosted Impact without need of a Turning Point.
A piece of a fresh corpse may be used instead of expending your stockpile (Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Sovereign Lion
gear.description: Majestic but unruly big cat.

notes.text: Unruliness scales Low–High with its size (Mid if not Reskinned).
May unleash a mighty roar to briefly inspire awe in non-allies within earshot, scaling on proximity (Low Duration, Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Diving Falcon
gear.description: Exceptionally well-trained bird of prey.

notes.text: Gains Boosted striking force and toughness while diving to attack, inversely scaling up to High with its size (Mid if not Reskinned, no Boost if larger than a condor).
May screech to mark a target within earshot, rendering them visible to the owner and their Companions; the falcon’s next dive at that target has Mid Boosted speed (Low Duration, Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Coiling Serpent
gear.description: Languid bushmaster snake, docile unless threatened.

notes.text: Up to High Boosted Toughness, scaling with its size (Mid if not Reskinned), and venom of up to High deadliness, scaling inversely with its size (Low if not Reskinned).
May hiss to cause enemies within earshot to fear this snake while they remain within Low Range (Mid Cooldown).

name: BOGATYR
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Those who bow run the risk of losing their head.”
overview: You are a cheeky adventurer, beloved by the common folk for your bravado and wit. You are great at making friends and even better at frustrating your enemies, able to hold your own against terrifying foes, though your high-risk playstyle and poor defenses can lead to catastrophe when approached carelessly.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should ensure you have plenty of neutral NPCs to win over. You fare best when you can aggravate an enemy before the fight begins, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could present groups of smart enemies who can’t all be interacted with at once.
grounding: Grounded in Central European and Slavic folk heroes, arrogant and clever, whose feats have been mythologized over time by their larger-than-life personas.
examples_heading: Examples from history, folklore, and pop culture include:
examples: Nikita the Tanner, Juraj Jánošík, Suur Tõll, and other Central and Eastern European folklore heroes
Ser Duncan the Tall (A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Bogatyr besides Vitality, Might, and Luck? Consider Vigor, Resilience, or Skill!
Between its risky playstyle and situational defenses, this Class is very prone to injuries; try to avoid drawing fire until you’re ready to take it.

abilities.name: Friend in Need
abilities.description: Receive a mundane object from an NPC, later Pitching a magical property it holds.
abilities.paired_action: Befriend a downtrodden local, then Pitch a simple item they give you.

notes.text: Magical property is only Pitched when your character first attempts to use the object (for its intended purpose or otherwise). Duration does not start until this point.

children.text: This property has Mid–High Impact, scaling on how seemingly useless the object is.
Your character should initially have no idea of the object’s potential, though they will instinctively learn of the magical property as soon as it is Pitched.

abilities.name: Samosek
abilities.description: Briefly animate a weapon or tool you own or have been given to perform a simple task, hovering around and operating itself as a temporary, simple-minded companion.
abilities.paired_action: Throw the object towards its task while calling out some basic orders to it. You must occasionally yell encouragement to the item or Samosek will end prematurely.

notes.text: Your initiating throw must put the object within a Low Range of its intended task.
Tasks beyond the intended use of the object will be performed less effectively. (e.g. A sword would fight better than a kitchen knife but would have much more trouble preparing food.)
May instead use on an abandoned object, though this increases Essence Cost to Mid and requires substantially more cajoling via the Paired Action.
Ends early if the task is completed or the object is thwarted (defeated, pinned, task too substantial, etc.).

abilities.name: Trading Blows
abilities.description: Lock an enemy into a harmless duel, during which neither you nor they can sustain a serious wound.
abilities.paired_action: Provoke the target into attacking you. You must occasionally mock or goad the target or Trading Blows will end prematurely.

notes.text: Harm incurred by either the user or the target is dramatically reduced, rarely exceeding scratches and bruises.

children.text: Instead, successful blows will proportionately sap the target’s dignity, making them look physically disheveled and feel increasingly frustrated, flustered, or similar.

notes.text: All other beings are strongly compelled to not interfere with this duel. However, successful blows against the user will proportionately reduce this compulsion for enemies, eventually negating it outright.

gear.name: Spangenhelm
gear.description: Conical helmet with a nose guard and cheek plates.

notes.text: Pointedly doff this helmet while speaking with a non-enemy to make them feel comfortable around the owner (1x Use).
Pointedly don this helmet while speaking with an enemy to make them feel intimidated by the owner (1x Use).

gear.name: Vyshyvanka
gear.description: Plain linen shirt.

notes.text: Common folk will tend to trust the owner.
Magically embroidered with depictions of “great” deeds the owner accomplishes, Pitched (and embellished) as they occur.

children.text: You may Pitch that a local recognizes your character for one of these deeds (1x Use per deed).

gear.name: Bludgeon
gear.description: Heavy wooden club.

notes.text: Strikes send targets flying with Low–High Impact, scaling on the target’s frustration, humiliation, or similar.

gear.name: Earspoon
gear.description: Two-handed, lugged spear.

notes.text: This spear may be wielded one-handed alongside food or drink, gaining Boosted nimbleness to compensate.
After defeating enemies with this spear, you may conjure a fitting prepared food item, determined via Pitch, with quantity and quality scaling on their threat level.

children.text: Slaying a gameworthy animal (or similar) may replace its corpse with a prepared dish thereof.

notes.text: This spear gains up to High Boosted deadliness, scaling on how contentedly full its owner is.
Gradually refilled while the owner is in combat.
Rapidly inebriates any drinker, though they will sober up after only a Mid Duration.

children.text: If the owner becomes drunk in this way, they gain a Low–High Boost to their toughness, scaling on believable portrayal of this Altered State.

gear.name: Bindle
gear.description: Cloth bundle tied to the end of a stick, carried over the shoulder.

notes.text: Contains small tools and snacks, accessed via Pitches.

children.text: Once per mission, such a Pitch may produce a tool or food item of dramatically disproportionate size (an anvil, a wedding cake, etc.), which the owner treats as much lighter for a Low Duration.

name: BRAINIAC
stat_note: *Two Personality Traits are left up to player choice; no Stat besides the listed one may be brought above two pluses.
quote: “I am more than amused by the prospect of a battle of wits ... though I fear that with you as an opponent... the struggle might well be brief.”
overview: You are a maniacal innovator, whose wild schemes are facilitated by a vast arsenal of eccentric devices. You are charismatic and dangerously brilliant, though your great hubris can leave you prone to spectacular mishaps.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should feel free to give you powerful enemies and complex problems, both of which you can be well-equipped to take on. Bystanders and minor NPCs are an important part of your gameplan, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could make a smaller-scale setting where a captive audience is harder to amass.
grounding: Grounded in over-the-top geniuses too smart for their own good, often with dreams of world domination, the perennial antagonists of pop culture heroes.
examples_heading: Examples from folklore & pop culture include:
examples: Dr. Doom, Megamind, Doc Ock, Syndrome, and countless other comic book and movie supervillains
Eggman, Neo Cortex, and other video game antagonists
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Brainiac besides Intelligence? Consider Vitality, Resilience, or Arcane!
Make sure you understand Pitching before playing this Class.
Be ready to talk a lot: this is a bombastic Class, especially in its Paired Actions.

abilities.name: Behold!
abilities.description: Reveal and activate an elaborate, single-use contraption from a Pitched hidden location, no matter how implausible.
abilities.paired_action: Gleefully introduce the contraption and explain it at length; activate it only after you finish doing so.

notes.text: The contraption’s nature and capacities are also Pitched and must be thematically appropriate to the user.

children.text: The contraption’s actual Impact, once activated, scales Low–High on the size of the user’s audience. (e.g. A giant robot revealed to a large crowd could operate as intended with High Impact but would break or go awry if revealed to just a handful of people, yielding only Low Impact.)
After being used, the contraption will break, run out of power, or otherwise be rendered defunct. Duration scales as appropriate to the contraption's intended function.

abilities.name: Do the Thing!
abilities.description: Order an underling to perform a simple physical task for you with untroubled compliance.
abilities.paired_action: Issue a command in a smug or imperious fashion.

notes.text: Impact scales Low–High on how unimportant the target is (Mid at maximum when targeting an enemy).
Compliance ends as soon as the task is performed.
You may Pitch how the attempt to complete the task goes completely wrong for your character while the target remains unscathed; if you do so, this Ability’s Cost and Cooldown are negated.

abilities.name: Your Only Weakness!
abilities.description: Pitch a physical weakness or character flaw in an enemy and pontificate about it at length, compelling the target to pay attention and not interrupt your monologuing.
abilities.paired_action: Gloatingly explain for a Low Duration how you learned of and plan to exploit the Pitched weakness.

notes.text: If the Pitched weakness would logically apply to multiple present enemies, all of them may be affected by the compulsion, though doing so increases this Ability’s Cooldown to High.
If the Paired Action is interrupted, this Ability’s Impact is reduced to Low (normally Mid).

gear.name: Powersuit
gear.description: Full-body suit of mechanized armor with an obvious weak spot. Stored in a compact briefcase, deployed to encase the user over several seconds and retracted at will.

notes.text: Pitch a physical Mid Boost for this suit to convey its owner (strength, jumping distance, etc.) as well as a thematically related Mid Impact malfunction incurred in the process, both of which reset when the suit is retracted.
If damage is sustained to this suit’s weak spot, Pitch a High Impact malfunction (which does not reset).

gear.name: Universal Adapter
gear.description: Small implant embedded in a finger.

notes.text: The owner may interface with technology or comparable objects through prolonged contact.

children.text: Up to a Mid Duration, scaling on how complex and tamper-proof the target is.

gear.name: Thrusters
gear.description: Miniature single-use rockets, powerful enough to carry a person’s weight.

notes.text: Affixable to any solid object.
Whenever used, Pitch a Low Impact malfunction.
Explode upon collision, causing Mid Damage.

gear.name: Attenuator
gear.description: High-tech gauntlet, which may fire a continuous beam.

notes.text: Any target struck by this beam is frozen in space while it is held on them, during which time they are immune to harm (Low Max Duration).

children.text: Beings who fiercely struggle may break free early (even within seconds), though this is rendered less likely if the owner harangues them while they are frozen.

gear.name: Gantry
gear.description: Set of oversized mechanical arms ending in large grippers, sourced from a heavy backpack; much stronger and tougher but less agile and dextrous than regular limbs.

notes.text: Pitch a tool to replace one or both grippers (1x Use).

children.text: The owner may freely swap between the two for the rest of the mission.

gear.name: Decoys
gear.description: Semi-convincing blow-up body doubles of the owner, deployed in seconds from wallet-sized packets. Break down at even minor resistance.

notes.text: Deployed decoys can be assigned simple tasks. (e.g. Walking, sweeping the floor, taking a phone call, etc.)

children.text: Completely inactive until tasked.

name: DRACHENTÖTER
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “So comes snow after fire, and even dragons have their ending!”
overview: You are a zealous slayer of dragons, rendering complex problems into towering beasts to be felled. Your combat capacities are highly specialized towards defeating monstrous, powerful enemies, though this grand, ponderous fighting style can leave you disproportionately susceptible to groups of smaller, quicker enemies.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should build settings with interesting dilemmas for you to turn into dragons to slay, though other enemies who are inherently large and dangerous are also a welcome addition. If the Conduit wants to really challenge you, they could create NPCs or locations that you need to protect from harm while your massive targets are rampaging around.
grounding: Grounded in the timeless trope of heroes vanquishing deadly monsters, often representing a greater issue being solved.
examples_heading: Examples from myth and pop culture include:
examples: Sigurd, St. George, Bellerophon, and other mythical dragonslayers
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Drachentöter besides Might, Resilience, and Will? Consider Skill, Spirit, or Vitality!
Make sure you understand Pitching before playing this Class.
Consider the size and weight of your weapons — your fighting style is not meant to be agile, and most of your strikes will need to be carefully telegraphed.

abilities.name: Sleeping Dragon
abilities.description: Conjure a powerful monster nearby, the physical embodiment of a systemic local issue; that issue is solved when the monster is slain.
abilities.paired_action: Decry the monster as the source of the problem and declare your intent to slay it.

notes.text: The monster will be aggressive and destructive towards locals affected by the chosen issue and even more so towards the user and their allies.

The monster’s appearance and capacities, as well as where it emerges, are all determined via Pitch, as befitting the locale and the issue it represents. (e.g. An intergenerational feud between seafaring merchant families could yield an ancient, rotting sea serpent attacking their shared harbor.)

children.text: This monster will always be at least as deadly as the user, surpassing them in threat level scaling on how seemingly unsolvable the issue is that they embody.
Too significant of an issue may yield an invincible monster.

notes.text: If the monster is slain, all locals affected by this issue it embodied will know and respect the slayer.

abilities.name: Strike True
abilities.description: Pitch and attack a weak spot, clearly visible only to you, on an enemy who exceeds you in power.
abilities.paired_action: After having fought the enemy for at least a Low Duration, recite a short prayer or declaration as you slowly prepare your attack.

notes.text: The user gains a Mid Ward against their target while performing the Paired Action.
The user’s strike against the weak spot gains Low–High Boosts to precision and deadliness, scaling on how much destruction their target has caused to their surroundings and allies.
Indicating the weak spot to an ally as part of the Paired Action will convey all of this Ability’s benefits to that ally, though the above Boosts are capped at Mid.

abilities.name: Cruor Haustus
abilities.description: Drink a monstrous enemy’s blood to take on a Pitched magical power and negative Quirk derived from them.
abilities.paired_action: Drink the blood, then portray a Turning Point grappling with the disgust of having done so.

notes.text: The power and Quirk must both thematically befit the enemy, with Impact scaling Low–High on how formidable that enemy was at their height.

children.text: The Quirk may be emotional or physical in nature, but it must be loathsome and purely negative. It lingers for the rest of the mission, even after this Ability’s expiry.

gear.name: Aureole
gear.description: Shining circlet emitting a gentle glow.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against fear-based effects and thematically related magics.

The owner may hold their head high and close their eyes to cause this circlet to emit a flash of light, dazzling all onlooking enemies the owner compellingly deems as evil, with Impact scaling Low–High on on how evil the owner believes them to be (Mid Essence Cost).

gear.name: Lorica Draconis
gear.description: Tunic made of interwoven dragon scales. Significantly tougher and lighter than typical armor.

notes.text: Protects against magical attacks as though they were physical.

Once per mission, Pitch the nature of the specific creature these scales were taken from to cause this armor to provide a Mid Ward against a related threat. (e.g. Scales from a hydra could protect against toxic fumes.)

gear.name: Great Bow
gear.description: Huge bow, taller than its user, with arrows the size of short spears and an enormous draw weight.

notes.text: Any shot that does not pierce a target outright will send that target flying (Mid Impact).
Hold an arrow at full draw to gradually improve its power over up to a Low Duration (Low Stamina Cost).

gear.name: Tabard
gear.description: Sleeveless, slitted outerwear, light and ornamental.

notes.text: Influential locals will tend to trust the owner.
If an influential local takes the owner on as a trusted subordinate, you may Pitch a completely new Reskin for this tabard to match their aesthetics.

children.text: You may then Pitch that your character is recognized as an affiliate of that local, and your character’s achievements will proportionately further that local’s prestige.

gear.name: Tilting Lance
gear.description: Heavy, two-handed lance with a large hand guard.

notes.text: When initiating a charge against an enemy, the user may dash a Mid distance towards them at incredible speed; Low–High Stamina Cost, inversely scaling on how terrifying that enemy is.

gear.name: Methorn
gear.description: Drinking horn full of sacred mead.

notes.text: Drink while swearing an oath of heroic duty to gain a Mid Boost to strength while pursuing that oath for a Mid Duration.

children.text: If the owner fulfills their oath before this effect expires, they restore a full Essence Threshold.
If the owner breaks, neglects, or otherwise goes back on their oath, even after this effect expires, they lose a full Essence Threshold.

name: GREYBEARD
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Do not meddle in the affairs of wizards, for they are subtle and quick to anger.”
quote_source: — Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: You are an authoritative wizard whose words often hold greater weight than your spellcraft. Your magic is slow and indirect, requiring time and commitment to be fully effective and often coming with self-inflicted downsides, but can have dramatic results when used wisely.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to give you time to think, not forcing you to take action too early so you have some room to set up. Your playstyle has a social core, requiring interactions with NPCs to set up many of your strongest powers, so if your Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try creating savvy, imperturbable enemies who don’t play into your hands.
grounding: Grounded in the trope of venerable magic users who rarely cast actual spells, the true extent of their mystical powers being a subject of much debate.
examples_heading: Examples from faith, folklore, & pop culture include:
examples: Odin, Moses, and similar venerable religious figures
Rubezahl, Morozko, Cailleach, & similar folkloric entities
Ogion the Silent (A Wizard of Earthsea)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Greybeard besides Vitality, Will, & Intelligence? Consider Arcane, Spirit, or Sensory!
Pace your play. This Class often strains itself, so try to avoid going all-out too early on in the mission, lest you leave yourself crippled when it matters most.

abilities.name: Great & Terrible
abilities.description: Wax wrathful to grow in size and surround yourself with a Pitched turbulent natural force (fire, wind, cold, etc.), which provides a Ward against hostile magic.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point showing your character exploding with well-founded exasperation, their severe mood lingering as an Altered State.

notes.text: Benefits scale Low–Mid on how intensely and compellingly you portray the Paired Action and Altered State.

children.text: Growth caps out at double the user’s normal size and also applies to any of their Equipment on their person.

Destructive forces must remain very close to the user, like an expansive cape. These cannot be directly controlled and will steadily harm anyone nearby (including, to a lesser degree, the user themselves).

notes.text: If the user calms down in a believable manner, this Ability will end prematurely.

abilities.name: Winds of Change
abilities.description: Pitch a temporary unseasonable change to immediately impose upon your surroundings, instilling either hope or dread in onlookers as fitting.
abilities.paired_action: Deliver a short, serious speech that aims to either embolden or dishearten its listeners.

notes.text: Cost scales on how implausible the Pitched change is. (Pulling a ray of pure sunlight through heavy smog would have a Low Cost; bringing heavy frost to a springtime meadow would have a Mid Cost; turning midday to midnight would have a High Cost.)

children.text: Only affects the user’s surroundings, rather than the entire locale.
The more plausible the Pitched change, the longer it takes to revert once the Ability ends (Mid at max).

abilities.name: Mímisbrunnr
abilities.description: Willingly endure great suffering to receive an internal answer from your Conduit to any chosen question.
abilities.paired_action: Ask a question to your Conduit while your character intentionally makes a bodily sacrifice (whether self-inflicted or by deliberately putting themselves in avoidable harm’s way).

notes.text: Answer Impact scales up to High on how much harm the user incurs through the Paired Action.

children.text: If self-inflicted, injuries sustained in this way are patched up to the point where they aren’t getting worse.

gear.name: Feathered Hat
gear.description: Decorated outdoorsman’s cap.

notes.text: Local wildlife will tend to trust the owner (Low Impact).
The owner’s voice may emit from any location at will (Mid Range).
The owner may uncannily imitate natural sounds, scaling on their familiarity therewith.
Provides a High Ward against natural environmental hazards.
Boosts the owner’s walking speed, scaling on how demonstrably deep in thought they are.
Hang up this cloak on a terrain feature to Pitch the existence of a simple nearby hideout and its modest supplies/furnishings (1x Use).
Boosts the volume of the owner’s voice while they are behaving in a dramatic, vehement fashion.

children.text: If this staff is fittingly brandished, these amplified words will push away anyone they are directed towards (Low Cost, Low Range).

gear.name: Churchwarden Pipe
gear.description: Long-stemmed pipe, magically lit with a tap.

notes.text: Smoking gradually renders the owner calm and contemplative as well as anyone else who remains in their immediate presence over a Low Duration (Mid Impact).

children.text: Exhaled smoke may be shaped and puppeted by the owner until it naturally fades.

gear.name: Orbuculum
gear.description: Delicate crystal ball.

notes.text: Peer into it to Pitch an event that will happen after a Low–Mid Delay.

children.text: If accepted, the owner sustains a spontaneous magical injury, with deadliness scaling up to High on how beneficial the Pitched event would be to them and their allies.

gear.name: Eye in the Sky
gear.description: Intelligent pet bird, capable of following sophisticated commands.

notes.text: May be telepathically recalled to the owner’s side at all.
You may Pitch that a being knows of your character and recognizes this bird as their emissary (Mid Cooldown).

children.text: Your character becomes aware when this happens and may send that being a Mid-length telepathic message.

name: LITHOMANCER
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Rock is a stubborn element. If you're going to move it, you've got to be like a rock yourself.”
quote_source: — Toph Beifong, Avatar: The Last Airbender
overview: You are a hardy earth mage whose power is drawn from the ground beneath your feet. You are a versatile combatant, able to both control the battlefield and brawl with equal ease, though you absolutely require contact with the ground in order to do so.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to give you plenty of natural earth to work with, though manmade derivatives like asphalt and concrete will work in a pinch. You have excellent utility outside of combat, great for exploring and interacting with your surroundings, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could create a hazardous environment that’s harder for you to manipulate.
grounding: Grounded in the elementalist niche of stone and earth manipulation, a favorite of video games and modern fantasy media
examples: Tremor, Aganos, Kragg, and other fighting game earth-wielders
Koth of the Hammer (Magic: The Gathering)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Lithomancer besides Resilience, Sensory, & Arcane? Consider Might, Will, or Vigor!
Make use of your Abilities’ low Costs and Cooldowns and use them frequently.

abilities.name: Tremor Sense
abilities.description: Strike the ground to receive an answer from your Conduit to a basic, spatial question about anything making contact with the ground after a brief delay.
abilities.paired_action: Impact the ground, then wait to feel the vibrations echo back.

notes.text: Range and delay both scale with the force applied through the Paired Action. (e.g. A tap of the foot would have a Low Range and a delay of mere seconds; slamming a heavy tool would have a High Range and a Low delay.)

Questions may have up to High Impact, scaling on how prominent the target is (due to its size, weight, movement, etc.). (e.g. A single, stationary human would only afford Low Impact; a parked vehicle would afford Mid Impact; a terrain feature like a house would afford High Impact.)

abilities.name: Geomorph
abilities.description: Pitch a small landform to abruptly rip from a chosen point in the earth.
abilities.paired_action: Manipulate natural earth in a manner befitting the Pitched landform.

notes.text: Impact, including the explosiveness of the landform’s appearance where desired, scale Low–High with the intensity and/or complexity of the user’s Paired Action.
Targeted earth returns to normal over a Low-Mid Duration scaling on the landform’s inherent stability.

abilities.name: Stoneskin
abilities.description: Turn yourself to solid rock, becoming extremely heavy and nigh-invulnerable to most harm but also completely blind.
abilities.paired_action: Tense your body. You must continue to do so or Stoneskin will end prematurely.

notes.text: The user’s agility is reduced, but they are otherwise unencumbered.
Certain threats may bypass Stoneskin’s protection as intuitive. (e.g. Jackhammer, psychic blast, drowning, etc.)

gear.name: Huaraches
gear.description: Thin-soled sandals made of simple cord.

notes.text: Provides a High Ward against natural, ground-based hazards (sharp stones, lava, quicksand, etc.).
Boosts the owner’s agility on rugged terrain (Mid Impact).
With a running start, the owner may slide across natural earth in a fully controlled manner akin to ice skating.

gear.name: Earthshapers
gear.description: Heavy gauntlets of shaped stone.

notes.text: Boosts the owner’s punching power (Mid Impact).
Plunge these gauntlets into natural earth to magically coat them with it, hardening into a simple Pitched shape (Low Cooldown).

gear.name: Circling Stones
gear.description: Belt of baseball-size stones, which may be set to magically orbit the user at will.

notes.text: Orbiting stones may be magically launched as projectiles or intercept incoming attacks, expending any stone(s) used.

gear.name: Safety Goggles
gear.description: Bulky protective eyewear.

notes.text: Boosts the owner’s visual clarity in low-visibility environments (dark, fog, sandstorm, etc.).
Tap the goggles to see through a nearby terrain feature for several seconds, Pitching a structural weakness that it has (Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Rock Maul
gear.description: Two-handed mallet with a stone head.

notes.text: Deals disproportionate damage to terrain features (High Impact).
With a big windup, slam the ground to create a cone-shaped shockwave along the ground, dealing Low damage and knocking back all in its path (Low Range, Low Cooldown).

gear.name: Prima Materia
gear.description: Pocket-sized lump of mysterious earthen matter.

notes.text: The owner may magically sculpt this matter into any Pitched shape, changing its composition as they do so.

children.text: Must remain composed of solid, earthen material (rock, metal, mineral, etc.).
This takes up to a Low Duration, scaling on the Impact of the change.

name: ODDBALL
quote: “The inner machinations of my mind are an enigma.”
overview: You are a good-natured misfit who marches to the sound of your own drum. You are as outlandishly strange as you are intelligent, inconveniencing foes rather than fighting and solving problems seemingly by accident.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should remember to give you puzzles to mull over and an interesting social landscape to disrupt. You are almost entirely harmless and equally defenseless, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could create vigilant threats who work to capture or detain rather than hurt you.
grounding: Grounded in the many off-the-wall eccentrics that populate pop culture and the brilliance, sincerity, and unintentional hilarity they are best known for.
examples_heading: Examples from history & pop culture include:
examples: Baron Münchhausen (The Adventures of Baron Münchhausen)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Oddball besides Luck & Intelligence? Consider Vitality, Spirit, or Will!
Make sure you understand Pitching & Insights before playing this Class.
This Class has many tools — Captain Obvious, Head in the Clouds, Doohickey — that explicitly involve other players. Be sure to go over these before the mission!

abilities.name: Captain Obvious
abilities.description: Pitch a disproportionately simple solution to a problem.
abilities.paired_action: Propose the solution aloud, then either try it yourself or prompt someone else to do so.

notes.text: Cost scales with the implausibility of the solution actually working (without the user bringing it up).

children.text: This Ability will fail outright if the problem is too complex or if the proposed solution isn’t actually tried.

notes.text: If a being attempts the proposed solution unprompted, you may Pitch how their attempt goes wrong.
Any other player whose character is within earshot may, with your permission, activate this Ability themselves (spending their Essence), with their solution coming from your character’s mouth.

abilities.name: Non Sequitur
abilities.description: Interrupt a conversation with a completely unrelated topic, distracting the speakers and briefly causing them to forget what they were originally talking about.
abilities.paired_action: Interject a wildly off-topic statement into a conversation.

notes.text: Impact scales Low–Mid on how effectively the user interrupts the conversation.
The user is also affected by this Ability.

abilities.name: Head in the Clouds
abilities.description: Enter a heady ramble, losing track of your surroundings until you eventually snap back to reality with an answer from your Conduit to a prominent question.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of lapsing into excited nonsense, babbling about memories, far-fetched theories, intrusive thoughts, or similar as an Altered State.

notes.text: Boosts the user’s Happenstance Low–Mid, scaling on how committedly you portray the Paired Action and Altered State.

children.text: Your fellow players and Conduit may make Happenstance Pitches on your behalf while this Ability lasts, treated as separate from your own Happenstance Pitching for Limiter purposes.

notes.text: If the user is significantly startled or interrupted, this Ability will end prematurely.

children.text: Answer Impact and Cooldown scale on how long the ramble lasted.
If interrupted before a Low Duration passes, the user receives no answer but Cooldown is reduced to Low.

gear.name: Lost Marbles
gear.description: Small tokens.

notes.text: Not brought onto the mission normally, instead scattered across the locale and found via Happenstance Pitches, with success scaling on the creativity of the proposed discovery location.

children.text: Whenever the owner is reunited with a marble, they receive a mission-relevant Insight of Low–High Impact, scaling on how many marbles they have already found.

notes.text: You may Pitch your character accidentally losing all three found marbles, rescattering them as above, to restore a full Essence Threshold but forget all Insights gleaned from them.

gear.name: Weirdness Coupons
gear.description: Slips of paper embellished with nonsensical “credentials”.

notes.text: Display a coupon while doing something wildly eccentric (but clearly not malicious) to expend it, strongly compelling onlookers to not interfere or question that behavior for a Mid Duration.

gear.name: Doohickey
gear.description: Odd gizmo, different every mission.

notes.text: Whenever this item first becomes relevant, choose another player (or the Conduit) to Pitch a completely new Reskin for this, reminiscent of a handheld daily object with an odd twist. (e.g. A hair dryer with a tiny propellor on top, a waffle iron with a speaker inside it, an umbrella made from window screen mesh, etc.)

children.text: You may Pitch a supernatural function with Low–Mid Impact for the item befitting its Reskin, with Uses scaling inversely with the Impact of this Pitch.

gear.name: Tinfoil Hat
gear.description: Goofy, handmade head covering.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against enemy mental effects.
Deliver an impassioned rant decrying something seemingly innocuous (rye bread, neon lights, the local mailman) as harmful to gain a High Ward against it (Mid Cooldown).

children.text: Any other being who is convinced of its harmfulness also gains a Low Ward against it.

gear.name: Mr. Sock
gear.description: Sock puppet.

notes.text: The owner’s voice may emit from this puppet’s mouth at will with a shifted pitch and timbre.
Happenstance Pitches directly involving this puppet have Mid Boosted Impact.
While the source character is not paying attention to it, this puppet becomes animate, speaking with its own voice and human intelligence, controlled primarily by the player.

children.text: Allies will instinctively understand that the puppet is a different person in this state.
May not speak to the source character, and becomes inanimate again as soon as they notice.

notes.text: Set the time on this clock and smack it to instantly change the time of day within the locale to match, an incessant ticking sound pervading the area while this lasts.

children.text: Low–Mid Duration, scaling inversely with how drastic the change is from the actual time of day.
Locals are very unlikely to question this change, falling into behavior appropriate to the new time.

name: RAUBRITTER
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Heaven offers nothing that a mercenary soul can desire.”
overview: You are a hardened robber-knight, using brigandage to keep up a façade of clout and splendor. Money and social status are your goals, acquired through brawling, pillaging, and thuggish intimidation tactics.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should ensure that there is some sort of rule of law for you to push against. Your playstyle is, at its core, that of a bully, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could create resolute, strong-willed locals able to resist your strongarm tactics.
grounding: Grounded in historical robber-knights, downtrodden and disenfranchised former nobles that resorted to crime to fund their lavish lifestyles, and similar characters in pop culture.
examples_heading: Examples from history & parallels in pop culture include:
examples: Götz von Berlichingen, Jan Žižka, The Dry Devil, Cesare Borgia, and comparable historical figures
The Smiling Knight (A Song of Ice and Fire)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Raubritter besides Resilience, Vigor, & Vitality? Consider Luck, Might, or Arcane!
Be ready to get mean when playing this Class – your Conduit will understand that it’s not directed at them personally!

abilities.name: Aufruhr
abilities.description: Cause criminal mayhem with Boosted strength, influencing nearby nonenemies to join in.
abilities.paired_action: Publicly behave in a flagrantly lawless, destructive manner.

notes.text: Influence to join the mayhem has up to Mid Impact, with those who do so also becoming proportionately more willing to heed the user’s orders.

children.text: Allies influenced to join receive a Low Boost to strength (the user receives a Mid Boost).
Even after the Ability ends, all who joined (including the user) will be slightly more inclined towards unruliness for the remainder of the mission.

abilities.name: Opprobrium
abilities.description: Conjure a writ granting you inordinate privileges in a target’s name.
abilities.paired_action: Bully a target into giving you permission to do something, even if they technically have no authority to do so.

notes.text: Flaunting the writ will automatically communicate its granted privileges to those nearby (without it needing to be read).

Supernaturally credible to non-allies of equal or lesser authority to the original target. (e.g. If you bullied a maid into giving you permission to ransack the silverware, other servants would be convinced but not the majordomo.)

children.text: If the legitimacy of your writ is challenged, this Ability will end prematurely.

abilities.name: Unverwüstlich
abilities.description: Spend wealth to heal an injury to the point where it isn’t getting worse and conjure a Pitched prosthetic to cover or replace it.
abilities.paired_action: Make a show of shaking off the wound while tossing away the necessary wealth, causing it to vanish.

notes.text: Wealth Cost scales on the severity of the wound and the utility of the prosthetic. (e.g. Covering a lost eye with an eyepatch would have a Low Wealth Cost; protecting a bad stomach wound with an armored plate would have a Mid Wealth Cost; replacing a lost hand with a vicelike iron claw would have a High Wealth Cost.)

children.text: The prosthetic must be grounded in the user’s Backstory but may have fantastical elements.

gear.name: Sumptuary Furs
gear.description: Gaudy jacket made of fine animal pelts.

notes.text: Social climbers will tend to gravitate towards the owner.
The owner may conjure an armor piece appropriate to their locale, determined via Pitch, by expending Low–Mid wealth proportionate to its quality (causing that wealth to vanish).

children.text: Indulgent food and drink may also be conjured in this manner, always of high quality, with Wealth Cost scaling on the quantity (supplying up to a Low-sized group).

gear.name: Morningstar
gear.description: Heavy spiked mace, with a short chain attaching its head to its haft.

notes.text: Visibly telegraphing an attack allows the owner to extend the mace’s chain for the duration of that strike.

children.text: Such strikes are minorly redirected towards delicates.

gear.name: Warchest
gear.description: Portable lockbox.

notes.text: Contains a Low amount of wealth in the form of local currency and luxury items, determined via Pitch.

children.text: Magically fills with more wealth as the user commits crimes and causes destruction, scaling beyond High with the extent of the user’s lawlessness.
Once a Mid amount of wealth has accumulated, bragging about it to enemies will influence them to try to take it by force.

gear.name: Langes Messer
gear.description: Single-edged hewing sword, heavy but one-handed.

notes.text: Containers this sword cuts may spill Pitched contents disproportionate to their observable capacity (Low Cooldown).

gear.name: Hand Cannon
gear.description: Primitive firearm mounted on a pole, firing fist-sized stones with a thunderous boom. Notably cumbersome to reload.

notes.text: Can load and fire any miscellaneous items that fit snugly in its barrel. Each time this is done, the barrel sustains Low damage.

children.text: If sufficiently damaged, this firearm will violently explode when next fired, the owner only sustaining Low collateral damage no matter their proximity.

gear.name: Knecht
gear.description: Surly apprentice-at-arms. Equipped with melee weapons and armor grounded in the source character's Backstory.

notes.text: Notably insubordinate, only begrudgingly obeying most orders, but still controlled primarily by the player.
Indulge this apprentice with a Mid amount of money, fine food, or other luxuries to give them a Mid Boost to any Pitched attribute (Low Duration).

children.text: If the Knecht makes the source character look bad, this Boost will last for the rest of the mission.

name: SHŌNEN
quote: “As you think, so shall you become.”
overview: You are an irrepressible martial artist with an indomitable fighting spirit. Despite your lack of armor and (oftentimes) weapons, you are never to be underestimated, even after a crippling defeat, due to your remarkable tenacity and sudden bursts of incredible power.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to give you plenty of combat, whether hordes of mooks or individual mighty foes. You can have serious trouble walking away from a fight, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could employ tricky enemies who can effectively goad you into compromising positions.
grounding: Grounded in young, idealistic warrior protagonists, most commonly found in anime and manga.
examples_heading: Examples from myth & pop culture include:
examples: Naruto Uzumaki, Ryūko Matoi, & countless other anime/manga protagonists
Ryu, Jin Kazama, & other flagship fighting game characters
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Shōnen besides Will & Vigor? Consider Skill, Might, or Reflex!
Make sure you understand Turning Points & Altered States before playing this Class.
This Class spends lots of Stamina & Essence and often gets hurt, so be ready to portray injuries and Exhaustion.

abilities.name: Limit Break
abilities.description: Greatly enhance your speed but spend more Stamina for all actions. Once per use, you may teleport into melee striking distance of a nearby enemy.
abilities.paired_action: Comment on how your enemies have underestimated you, disrespected you, or similar.

notes.text: Teleport has a Low Range, may only target an enemy the user is physically capable of reaching, and incurs an additional Mid Stamina Cost.

abilities.name: Never Say Die
abilities.description: Swear a vow of tenacity to bypass one of your current Cooldowns and patch up your wounds, no matter how severe, to the point where they aren’t getting worse.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point swearing the vow to yourself or another, emphasizing its personal importance.

notes.text: Cost scales on the current length of the Cooldown you are trying to bypass (Low–Mid).
If the user breaks, neglects, or otherwise goes back on their sworn vow, this Ability may not be used again for the remainder of the mission.

abilities.name: Ultimate Strike
abilities.description: A devastating magical attack that may only target a given enemy once per mission.
abilities.paired_action: After fighting your target for at least a Low Duration, elaborately “charge up” the attack for several seconds, then dramatically announce a fitting name for it.

notes.text: Functionally enhances a purely offensive Manifestation, with the Boost Impact scaling Mid–High on how long the user has been fighting their target for (up to a Mid Duration).
Prolonging the Paired Action for up to a Low Duration will increase this Ability’s area of effect by up to Mid, though doing so will also increase its Cost to High.

gear.name: Hachimaki
gear.description: Cloth headband.

notes.text: Provides a Low Ward against enemy-sourced mental effects.
Portray a Turning Point of bravery or personal sacrifice to grant a Mid Boost to the effectiveness of the owner’s next attack.

gear.name: Gi
gear.description: Martial arts uniform.

notes.text: The owner may give a resolute shout during combat to glow with mystical energy, granting a Ward against hostile magics and infusing their unarmed strikes with magical power until they stop fighting (Mid Cooldown).

children.text: Impact scales Low–Mid on the owner’s emotional expressiveness.

gear.name: Divine Fruit
gear.description: Small berry.

notes.text: Any being may eat this fruit to be instantly healed (Mid Impact) and restore a full Stamina Threshold.

children.text: The consumer enters an Altered State of extreme overconfidence (Mid Duration).

gear.name: Training Weights
gear.description: Weighted bands worn on the arms and/or legs.

notes.text: Significantly encumber the user’s movements and increase their Stamina Costs.

Remove the weights to gain Boosted speed and strength and reduce Stamina Costs for a Low Duration, with Impact scaling Low–High on how compellingly you have portrayed the weights’ encumbrance since the mission started or they were last removed.

gear.name: Ancestral Blade
gear.description: Legendary weapon, pristine despite its age.

notes.text: Speak a one-sentence prayer into this blade to grant it a Pitched Mid Boost to any property thematically linked to that prayer (Low Cost, Low Duration).

gear.name: Flying Cloud
gear.description: Small cloud, which the owner may stand atop and pilot at will. Only large enough for the owner alone, cannot accommodate passengers.

notes.text: Not brought onto the mission normally, instead summoned under the owner’s feet at will, vanishing after they fly a Mid total distance with it (Mid Cooldown).

children.text: If flown into combat, Cooldown is reduced to Low.

name: ZOOLOGIST
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “The smallest frog has more mystery in it than all the stars in the sky.”
overview: You are an enthusiastic wildlife researcher with an infectious passion for animals. You seem to know everything there is to know about any creature you come across and are remarkably good at getting them to cooperate, though your actual authority over them is limited.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to include animals where possible but do not need to do so excessively — your kit can easily provide all the critters you’ll need. Consistency is not your specialty, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could put you in a setting where an animal on the loose will likely be quickly captured or subdued.
grounding: Grounded in larger-than-life naturalists sharing their love of animals with the world and the many functional characters they have inspired.
examples_heading: Examples from contemporary history & pop culture include:
examples: Steve Irwin, Jane Goodall, David Attenborough, the Kratt Brothers, and other modern wildlife educators
Newt Scamander (Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them)
Professors Oak, Birch, Juniper, and others (Pokémon)
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Zoologist besides Vitality, Vigor, & Intelligence? Consider Spirit, Sensory, or Skill!
Be sure you understand Pitching before playing this Class.

abilities.name: In the Wild
abilities.description: Conjure a wild animal, causing it to appear from a hidden spot nearby, and Pitch its mood.
abilities.paired_action: Enthusiastically introduce the animal to someone nearby as it appears, sharing some interesting trivia about it.

notes.text: Animal must be grounded in the user’s Backstory; it does not need to be plausible for the locale.

Cost and Cooldown scale on how much of a threat the animal poses to those in the vicinity besides the user. (e.g. A large shark conjured at an aquarium would have a Low Cost and Cooldown; one conjured while diving at sea would have a Mid Cost & Cooldown.)

children.text: Animals that would pose a High threat or greater cannot be conjured.

abilities.name: Crikey!
abilities.description: Mount an unwilling animal; it gains Boosted strength and toughness and enters a ferocious rampage, which the user is largely protected from and may minorly steer.
abilities.paired_action: Leap onto the target’s back or similar. You must hang on for at least a Low Duration, or Crikey! will end prematurely.

notes.text: The user’s initiating leap and clinging tenacity (per the Paired Action) are both somewhat empowered.
Lasts until the animal is calmed down or exhausts itself (even if the user dismounts after a Low Duration).

children.text: Gentle, caring actions and words from the user will disproportionately calm the animal.
If fully calmed in this way, the animal will tend to trust the owner (Mid Impact).

abilities.name: Documentary Voice
abilities.description: Pitch elements of an animal’s behavior and morphology while observing it.
abilities.paired_action: Continuously narrate the actions of an animal you are observing aloud, earnestly noting its captivating traits and behaviors as they are Pitched.

notes.text: Accepted traits are immediately exhibited by the observed animal and should be taken as having been true all along. May continue to make new Pitches so long as the Paired Action is sustained.

children.text: Pitches may apply to the entire species rather than just the observed individual.

notes.text: Pitches may, in total, exceed High Impact, scaling on how engaging and natural your narration is.
The user is concealed from the target (including their voice) while this Ability lasts.

gear.name: Pith Helmet
gear.description: Lightly protective, wide-brimmed hat with a core of spongy wood.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against natural environmental hazards.
While the user keeps quiet, slow, and low to the ground, local foliage will gradually sprout over a Low Duration to conceal them and allies in the immediate vicinity doing likewise.

gear.name: Control Pole
gear.description: Sturdy pole with an ensnaring loop at the end, standing at shoulder height.

notes.text: Ensnared targets are far less able to damage or escape this item.
Haft may be telescopically extended or contracted at will (capping out at triple normal length).
While moving this pole very slowly, it is much less likely to be noticed.

gear.name: Pocket Critters
gear.description: Small, safe-to-handle animals, stashed in indeterminate locations on your person.

notes.text: Pitch a critter as you reveal it while commenting on a behavior it is known for; it will promptly demonstrate that behavior.

gear.name: Dart Gun
gear.description: Long-barreled air gun, firing with a brief hiss; launches tranquilizer darts that inflict no damage.

notes.text: Forcibly sedates and heals the target, scaling on how panicked, enraged, or similar they are.

children.text: Impact caps out at High against creatures and Mid against humans and other sapient species.

gear.name: Field Journal
gear.description: Full of notes and sketches.

notes.text: Document an animal or natural phenomenon in this journal to receive an answer to a Mid Impact question about it from your Conduit.

children.text: The animal or phenomenon will remain as it was while the owner documents it.
Give this journal to a prominent local to make these documented notes publicly known within the locale over a Mid Duration.

gear.name: Animal Cam
gear.description: Concealed camera in a clumsy, harmless, robotic animal replica, which operates autonomously as a playful Companion when deployed.

notes.text: Not brought onto the mission normally, instead summoned to the owner’s side at will with a Pitched Reskin.
Encourages playfulness and curiosity in beings it interacts with, particularly those it is Reskinned to look like.

children.text: Unlikely to be noticed otherwise.

notes.text: Must be recovered to access recorded footage.

name: ARDENT
overview: You are a martial channeler of emotions, transforming your own big feelings into physical power. You are a highly versatile combatant, able to match most opponents no matter their style or numbers, but your playstyle is very resource-intensive while also requiring heavy acting commitment.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to give you plenty of fights — despite your focus on emotion, you are a combat Class first and foremost. You thrive when you care, given time to build strong feelings, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try creating complex scenarios that pull you in many emotional directions.
grounding: Grounded in the trope of emotion-fueled martial prowess, infused with Wuxia-inspired aesthetics and themes of self-mastery.
examples_heading: Examples from literature and pop culture include:
examples: Yang Guo (The Return of the Condor Heroes)
tips: Stuck on which Stats to give your Ardent besides Will and Might? Consider Skill, Vigor, or Spirit.
Be sure you understand Turning Points before playing this Class.
This is one of the most acting-heavy Classes in the game. Be ready to portray many different emotions in rapid succession.

abilities.name: Mood Swing
abilities.description: Greatly magnify a chosen emotion while also Boosting a related Pitched physical capacity.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a brief Turning Point of predominantly experiencing the chosen emotion and continue to do so as an Altered State.

notes.text: Boost Impact scales Low–High on how compellingly you portray the Paired Action and Altered State.

children.text: Pitched physical capacity must thematically match the chosen emotion. (e.g. Anger could Boost strength, sadness could Boost heaviness, or similar.)
If you choose the same emotion with your next use of this Ability, Boost Impact is capped at Low.

notes.text: Once the Duration elapses, the chosen emotion may naturally linger but is no longer intensified.

abilities.name: Outburst
abilities.description: Release a magical explosion of repressed emotion.
abilities.paired_action: Gradually portray your character trying to hold back volatile feelings, finally unleashing them as a Turning Point.

notes.text: Essence Cost scales inversely on how long the user has performed the Paired Action for, up to a Mid Duration.
Incorporate a martial strike into the culminating Turning Point to direct the magical explosion from that strike in a focused cone.
After using this Ability, the user is relaxed for a Mid Duration.

abilities.name: Zen Slap
abilities.description: Parry a single incoming attack with a lightning-fast palm strike.
abilities.paired_action: Maintain composed concentration while striking with an open hand.

notes.text: Parry effectiveness can also scale beyond High, scaling on the force of the user’s strike. Also provides beyond High Boosts to the speed, accuracy, and toughness of the user’s hand for the purposes of this parry.
Alternatively, may strike the target of a Defiance to Boost that Defiance by Low–High, scaling on the force of the strike.

children.text: The user may target themselves with this, bypassing the need for composed concentration during the Paired Action.
Actual harm inflicted by such a slap is capped at Low, no matter the user’s strength.
This alternate use case puts this Ability on a Low–High Cooldown, scaling on the Impact of the Defied effect.

gear.name: Gut-Punchers
gear.description: Light combat gloves.

notes.text: Boost owner’s punching power, scaling Low–High with the portrayed intensity of their current emotional state.

May negate all damage from a strike with these gloves to trigger a sudden, overwhelming surge of emotion in the target, opposite to what they had previously been expressing (Low Duration, 1x Use per target).

children.text: Low–High Impact, scaling on negated damage.

gear.name: Heartsleeves
gear.description: Ornamental sleeves, changing color to match the owner’s mood; the rest of the garment is mundane.

notes.text: Parries magical attacks (like a gauntlet would a sword).

Pitch a Low–Mid Ward against a specific magic thematically related or opposed to the owner’s current mood, scaling on how compellingly you are portraying that mood (Mid Essence Cost, 1x Use per mood).

children.text: Lasts until mood substantially changes.

gear.name: Façade
gear.description: Porcelain half mask.

notes.text: When donned by the owner, they become completely unable to feel a chosen emotion.

children.text: Whenever this emotion would have been substantially felt, this mask is proportionately damaged. After 2x instances, this may break the mask outright.

Upon breaking in this way, the owner must activate an Ability (if able), bypassing any character-sourced Paired Action to do so; that Ability is altered and empowered in a manner thematically befitting the newly-unrepressed emotion, determined via Pitch (Mid Impact).

gear.name: Grounding Talisman
gear.description: Simple necklace with deep personal value.

notes.text: Touching this talisman while breathing deeply will lock the owner into an Altered State of levelheaded calm, becoming resistant to being moved, physically or emotionally, by others (High Impact, Low Duration).

gear.name: Personal Bubble
gear.description: Belt with a large gem at the center.

notes.text: Touch the gem to push away all beings within arm’s reach of the owner (Mid Cooldown).

children.text: Push force scales up to Mid, scaling on how upset the owner is with a given target.
A spherical, magical barrier lingers around the owner while they continue to touch the gem, incurring a Mid Cost for each Low Duration it is sustained for (Mid Impact).

gear.name: Dark Iron Bar
gear.description: Absurdly heavy, sword-shaped metal bar, standing as tall as the owner.

notes.text: Successful Defiances made by the owner will incrementally Boost this bar’s lightness and swiftness (both beyond High at maximum), scaling on the Impact of the Defied effect.
Deals disproportionate damage to anything used to block or parry its strikes (High Impact).

name: OFFDRIVER
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “Up the airy mountain, | Down the rushy glen, | We daren’t go a-hunting | For fear of little men.”
overview: You are an offbeat fairy hunter, capturing, repelling, or eliminating capricious magical beings just beyond the view of mundane society. You are wildly effective against supernatural creatures, with many ways to flush out, trick, and cripple them, but this highly-specialized skillset leaves you with few tools against more mundane threats.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should shoot for an interesting mix of threats. An obvious supernatural enemy isn’t always mandatory, since you can easily find one yourself, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could instead focus on making smart, nuanced enemies that are harder for you to outfox.
grounding: Grounded in the relatively uncommon trope of fairy exterminators alongside a heavy dose of traditional folklore, particularly from the British Isles.
examples_heading: Examples from games and pop culture include:
examples: Big Jack Horner (Puss in Boots: The Last Wish)
Wizards of the Black Circle (Winx Club)
tips: Stuck on which Stats to give your Offdriver besides Sensory, Will, and Luck? Consider Intelligence, Reflex, or Arcane.
Be sure you understand Wards before playing this Class.
This is one of the more mechanically-intricate Classes in the game. Be sure to thoroughly review its capabilities before your first session.

abilities.name: Lay Bare
abilities.description: Reveal a peculiar local being to be a supernatural being in disguise; they become very hostile to the user as well as desperate to conceal their true nature from others.
abilities.paired_action: Physically disturb the target’s body, Pitching their true nature plus a telltale sign of it that is revealed and some thematic Quirks with Mid total Impact.

notes.text: Manifestations the target uses that are thematic to their Pitched true nature are notably Boosted (Mid Impact), though they will only ever willingly use these while trying to harm the user.

children.text: The target’s hostility towards the user is superseded by their desire to hide their true nature, especially from other locals.
The Pitched supernatural being must be either appropriate to the locale or grounded in the user’s Backstory.

notes.text: The user may target themselves by also portraying a Turning Point grappling with their own fey nature, with behavioral Quirks becoming a potent Altered State. This limits the effects to a Low Duration and sets the Essence Cost to High.

abilities.name: Object of Desire
abilities.description: Enchant an object to be actively coveted by supernatural locals and also gain a Low Ward against mundane locals.
abilities.paired_action: Whisper a short, fitting incantation into the object.

notes.text: Covetousness has Low–High Impact, scaling on how fitting the Paired Action is. Has no effect on supernatural beings that the affected object is not thematically appropriate to.

children.text: When used, the user may choose for the covetousness to also affect physiologically mundane beings who are magically-gifted (instead of the Ward).

abilities.name: As It Was
abilities.description: Wipe evidence of magical activity from a single source within an area, dispelling lingering effects and causing local witnesses to forget that they saw it.
abilities.paired_action: Completely neutralize the magic’s source within the area (by killing it, capturing it, removing it, or whatever else).

notes.text: Cost & Cooldown scale with the extent of evidence being wiped/lingering magic being dispelled.

children.text: Physical damage caused by the magic (to people and objects) remains.

notes.text: Range does not apply to witnesses: all locals who saw the affected magic have their memory of it wiped.
The affected area gains a High Ward against the magic’s source, preventing it from returning.

gear.name: Reversible Coat
gear.description: Knee-length overcoat with a drab exterior and patterned interior.

notes.text: While worn right side out, makes mundane beings less likely to notice the owner (Mid Impact).
While worn inside out, gives the user a High Ward against magical forms of detection, identification, and similar.
The owner may walk (not run) backwards as quickly and easily as they can walk forwards.

gear.name: Pinshooter
gear.description: Semiautomatic airgun, firing with a pop. Shoots small tacks, which embed with a sting but only leave shallow wounds, ineffective against physical armor.

notes.text: Almost perfectly bypasses magical defenses.

Embedded tacks minorly prevent the target from using magic, scaling up to Mid based on how many are embedded and the size of the target. (e.g. A human would require 5 tacks to even reach Low Impact; a rat-sized creature would reach Mid Impact after just one.)

gear.name: Bottled Fairies
gear.description: Tiny supernatural beings trapped in bottles. Can hold a conversation through the glass.

notes.text: When first relevant, Pitch, in broad strokes, a trapped fairy’s behavior, powers, and how it was acquired.
Convince the fairy (by any means) to grant a Pitched, Low Impact magical benefit if released.

children.text: If insufficiently convinced, will instead hit the owner with a Pitched, Low Impact magical curse when released.
Immediately flees after doing either of the above. The empty bottle may be reused to capture a new, fitting target, refreshing one Use.

gear.name: Hobnail Boots
gear.description: Tough, iron-cleated footwear.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against hostile, ambient magic.
Any being or object pinned down under one of these boots is physically enfeebled, and other beings are compelled not to interfere while the owner does so (Mid Impact).
Captures a nonhuman creature on contact, shrinking it to a tiny size and negating its ability to harm the net while within.

children.text: Renders the target incapable of anything but trying to escape the net, which takes up to a Mid Duration scaling on the target’s original size and power. Exceptionally powerful targets escape immediately, breaking the net.
Creatures larger than a horse cannot be affected.

gear.name: Mouser
gear.description: Tough, ornery barn cat, primed to hunt small creatures and with a particular taste for magical ones.

notes.text: Does not heed commands but still controlled primarily by the player.

Inclined to occasionally bring its owner dead creatures as trophies. Whenever it does so, similar creatures become terrified of this cat and it gains a Ward against any attack made by them (Mid Impact).

name: SQUIRE
stat_note: *Choose from among all three when determining your two Class-based Personality Traits (the final may come from any Stat).
quote: “As a father you shall be to me,” said Merry. “For a little while,” said Théoden.
overview: You are a committed trainee, motivated by dreams of greatness. Your role is primarily supportive, assisting and protecting your allies, but occasionally you can flip the script to step into the spotlight yourself, though your swingy, acting-heavy playstyle can make big moments risky and inconsistent.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to ensure you have plenty of engaging, emotional plot hooks to get invested in. You are the ultimate underdog, provoking sympathy even in your enemies, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try creating NPCs whose hearts are wholly unable to be touched.
grounding: Grounded in actual medieval squiredom and associated tropes concerning duty, hero worship, and coming of age.
examples_heading: Examples from literature and pop culture include:
examples: Podrick Payne (A Song of Ice and Fire)
Raphtalia (The Rising of the Shield Hero)
tips: Stuck on which Stats to give your Squire besides Vigor, Spirit, and Will? Consider Resilience, Vitality, or Skill.
Be sure you understand Turning Points before playing this Class.
While being on the back foot is an important part of your skillset, your character does not need to be an incompetent klutz.

abilities.name: By Your Leave
abilities.description: Perform a simple, succinct physical task that has been given to you with Boosted speed and effectiveness.
abilities.paired_action: Earnestly acknowledge the task and its giver.

notes.text: If the task is completed to satisfaction, its giver will be more inclined to trust and appreciate the user, scaling Low–Mid on how important the task was.
Explicit approval or praise from the task giver will restore up to a Mid amount of the user’s Stamina or Essence, scaling on how meaningful it is to the user (1x Use per giver).

abilities.name: Entrust
abilities.description: Receive a useful or valuable item from a target whose trust you have earned, which gains a novel magical power while in your possession.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of mutual trust with the target, Pitching the item they give your character.

notes.text: May target another agent, with their player's permission; rather than making a Pitch, that player chooses which item is given.
The user becomes fully able to use the item and gains an Expertise with it, if applicable.

Magical power is also Pitched by the player, themed around what the user admires about the target, with Impact scaling up to High on how approving that target would be of how the item is currently being used. (e.g. A sword acquired from a target admired for their mercy could heal a wound it inflicted; at High Impact it could even mend a fatal one.)
If the user willingly returns the item, this Ability’s Cooldown is negated.

abilities.name: Be Brave
abilities.description: Enter into a hopeless duel against one or more targets who clearly outclass you.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of courage despite apparent fear of the target(s).

notes.text: Inspires admiration and concern in onlookers and enhances their Heartening towards the user, scaling on how outclassed the user is.
The duel lasts until one party is badly injured or surrenders. If the user loses the duel without surrendering, the targets are compelled to leave them and their allies alone.

children.text: The user is miraculously spared death, and wounds they incur are patched up enough that they won’t get worse.

gear.name: Waster
gear.description: Wooden training sword.

notes.text: Pitch how a combat action taken with this sword goes completely wrong to gain a Low Boost to a related physical attribute, such as strength, agility, or toughness.

children.text: Low–High Cooldown, inversely scaling on how consequential the Pitched combat mishap was. (e.g. Somehow being disarmed by a feeble enemy would have a High Cooldown; being disarmed by a deadly enemy would have a Low Cooldown.)

gear.name: Favor Token
gear.description: Meaningful keepsake, given to the owner by someone they care about.

notes.text: Portray a Turning Point reminiscing about the person who gave the owner this token to receive an Insight on a relevant topic themed around that person.

children.text: Up to High Impact, scaling on how poignantly you portray this Turning Point.

notes.text: If someone gives the owner a meaningful keepsake after this is used, it becomes another Favor Token.
When used to thoroughly wipe down a fitting object over a Low Duration, that object gains a Mid Boost to its splendor and durability for a Mid Duration.

children.text: When targeting someone else’s possession, you may also choose a supernatural property it carries with up to Mid Impact to improve by one Power Rating for this Duration as well.

gear.name: Shining Armor
gear.description: Suit of medium armor.

notes.text: This armor gains Boosted defense and glows brightly, the glare from which only affects enemies, scaling Low–High on how morally upstanding non-enemies broadly perceive the owner to be.

children.text: If any non-enemy condemns the owner, these Boosts are inverted, the armor becoming flimsy and shabby.

gear.name: Heirloom Weapon
gear.description: Passed down over generations. Must be Reskinned as a mundane weapon that could qualify as a Common Item.

notes.text: Portray a Turning Point of spiritual connection with this weapon to enter an Altered State of meditative self-assurance, fighting with High Boosts to both this weapon’s deadliness and the owner’s precision and hand speed (Low Duration, Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Escutcheon
gear.description: Elaborate heraldic shield carrying the coat of arms of a family, order, or similar group.

notes.text: Blocks magical attacks as though they were physical.

If the owner formally declares their affiliation with the group linked to the coat of arms on this shield, you may Pitch that a target already knows of that group and thinks well of them (Mid Cooldown).

name: BERSERKER
quote: “Who beat and blazed | Your trail of red, | Till Odin gazed | Upon the dead.”
overview: You are a bloodthirsty ravager, ready to throw yourself into combat without fear or hesitation. You pose a terrifying threat to anything you can get your hands on, but your battle-rage can render you as much a danger to your allies as to your enemies.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should, above all else, try to ensure you have enemies to brawl with and blood to spill without derailing the plot. While you hit hard and are tough to kill, you will tire quickly if you play incautiously, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you, they could try sending waves of enemies at you to wear you down over time.
grounding: Grounded in the tropes, myths, and underlying history surrounding battle rages and the warriors who channel them.
examples_heading: Examples from myth & pop culture include:
examples: Heracles, Cú Chulainn, Beowulf, and similar mythical heroes
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Berserker besides Might and Resilience? Consider Vigor, Will, or Reflex.
Be sure you understand Altered States before playing this Class.
“Don’t commit to Froth at the Mouth too soon, but when you do you'll find that both of your other Core Abilities synergize very well with it.” — Guy A.

abilities.name: Froth at the Mouth
abilities.description: Enter an uncontrollable battle fury in which the user’s strength, toughness, and speed are Boosted and their Stamina Costs are greatly reduced.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of succumbing to frenzied rage, proceeding then to indiscriminately attack whatever seems to be the closest threat (ally or enemy) as a potent Altered State.

notes.text: Benefits scale Low–High on how intensely and compellingly you portray the Paired Action and Altered State.
If the user is substantially healed, their pain soothed, or their anger calmed, this Ability will end prematurely.

abilities.name: Warp Spasm
abilities.description: Mightily empower a single strenuous action, briefly but painfully enlarging a relevant body part to do so.
abilities.paired_action: Fiercely strain, portraying intense pain and exertion for a few seconds.

notes.text: Empowerment, enlargement, Stamina Cost, and incurred pain all scale on how intensely you portray the Paired Action.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Enchant the blood you spill to gradually heal yourself and scald your enemies.
abilities.paired_action: Performatively revel in the violence you have caused (or are about to cause).

notes.text: Impact scales Low–Mid on how thoroughly soaked the user is with blood.
