children.text: Affects all blood the user themselves has spilled (whether before or after activating the Ability).

notes.text: Can affect other fitting substances besides blood if yielded from damage caused by the user. (e.g. Oil from a wrecked car; metal shavings from a smashed robot; sap from a hacked tree.)

gear.name: Pelt Panoply
gear.description: Collection of animal skins worn as armor, covering a substantial amount of the owner's body.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against cold and frost.
Fierce, wild animals will tend to trust the owner, especially carnivores.
Give an animalistic growl, snarl, or similar to convey a gruff, 1 word message to any wild animal who hears it (Low Cooldown).

gear.name: Battle Axe
gear.description: Two-handed, double-bitted axe standing at shoulder height.

notes.text: Durability is dramatically Boosted while striking.

Perform a dramatic wind-up with this axe for a few seconds to unleash a wild spinning attack with it, whirling on the spot with disproportionate speed and hurling away any target not cut through outright (Mid Stamina Cost).

gear.name: Spatha
gear.description: One-handed sword with a broad, double-edged blade and a small crossguard.

notes.text: If this sword is lost or destroyed, the owner may pull it, good as new, from the corpse of an enemy they have slain.
Breaking this sword while striking an enemy who is literally or functionally invulnerable will cause that target to be slightly harmed despite their invulnerability.

gear.name: Warpaint
gear.description: Stylized images daubed on exposed skin.

notes.text: Improves the wearer’s Defiance, scaling Low–Mid on the courage they are demonstrating against a significant threat.

Includes an additional application of Warpaint (stored in a small pot), which the owner may give to an ally before or during the mission or may themselves to touch up their Warpaint (requiring a Low Duration to apply).

gear.name: Beast Claws
gear.description: Set of large, clawlike blades hidden in the knuckles of both hands.

notes.text: May be deployed or retracted at will with an intense flexing of the hand, though this takes a few seconds and causes notable pain.

gear.name: Gaesa
gear.description: Large, broad-headed javelins, also effectively used in melee combat.

notes.text: Dramatically less susceptible to breaking by the owner’s own hands, bending wildly without snapping.
Boosts owner’s agility when used to facilitate acrobatics such as vaulting, balancing, or swinging.

name: FREERUNNER
quote: “The best part of falling is getting back up again.”
overview: You are a free-spirited urban gymnast, to whom the concrete jungle is a playground waiting to be explored. You have unparalleled mobility, which can be put to excellent use pestering enemies, but low raw power, making it easy for you to spin your wheels without impacting the mission.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should make sure that your mobility is not invalidated by their design: slow plots and flat, empty settings will give you little room to contribute. If the Conduit wants to really challenge you, they could try using severe environmental hazards to make you look before you leap.
grounding: Grounded in the modern sport of parkour and its extensive cultural impact, as well as related tropes found in video games, comics, and beyond.
examples_heading: Examples from pop culture & contemporary history include:
examples: David Belle, Sébastien Foucan, Dom Tomato, and other legendary parkour athletes
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Freerunner besides Vigor and Reflex? Consider Skill, Vitality, or Sensory.
An extremely accessible Class — great for beginners as well as those looking to explore kinesthetic gameplay.
“You’re not immune to gravity. A bad landing from a high fall can seriously hurt.” — Vera C.

abilities.name: Dérive
abilities.description: Pitch a convenient terrain feature, using it to perform a Boosted acrobatic movement.
abilities.paired_action: Notice the terrain feature and incorporate it into a fitting stunt.

notes.text: Boosted acrobatics are notably safer for the user than they would normally be. (e.g. While falling, catching and swinging from a protruding flagpole would be less likely to dislocate your arms).

abilities.name: Tag, You’re It
abilities.description: Encourage allies or goad non-allies into following you.
abilities.paired_action: Touch any number of targets then run away from them; if any target catches up or all targets stop pursuing you, this Ability will end prematurely.

notes.text: Affected allies gain Boosted speed and agility, scaling Low–Mid on how effectively you cheer them on
Affected non-allies are compelled to keep following you, no matter how difficult, scaling Low–Mid on how effectively you taunt them.

abilities.name: Hangtime
abilities.description: Perform an enormously empowered jump that draws the eyes of onlookers.
abilities.paired_action: Briefly pause, then take a conspicuous running start into the jump.

notes.text: Attacks made against the user during this jump are notably less accurate, scaling Low–Mid on how death-defying and impressive the jump is (the eye-catching effect scaling in the same manner).
The user is fully spared the falling impact of this jump’s height (but not any additional drop beyond that).

gear.name: Sneakers
gear.description: Laced sporting shoes.

notes.text: Boosts the owner’s jump height, running acceleration and deceleration, and general foot dexterity.
Reduces falling impact when landing feet-first with good form.

gear.name: Sportswear
gear.description: Branded athletic apparel.

notes.text: Provides a Low Ward against weather such as sun, wind, or rain.
Athletes and sporting fans will tend to trust the owner.
All but negates Yellow Stamina Exhaustion (though Green & Red remain normal).

gear.name: Tonfa
gear.description: Pair of short baton weapons with perpendicular handles.

notes.text: Uppercut-style strikes knocked targets into the air; the owner may dash at incredible speed after a target knocked airborne in this way (Low Cooldown).

gear.name: Grapple Gun
gear.description: Heavy pistol firing a retractable cable tipped with a tether, requiring a few seconds to fully retract before being fired again.

notes.text: Quickly pulls the owner towards any terrain feature or large object the tether finds purchase on, detaching once they reach it.

children.text: Much less effective against beings and small objects, dealing minor damage and finding no purchase.

notes.text: Negates all of the drinker’s current Stamina Exhaustion and grants them a significant speed Boost for a Mid Duration.

children.text: Upon expiry, the drinker crashes, experiencing increasing lethargy and irritability until they drink another.

gear.name: Slap Tags
gear.description: Collection of identical, stylized stickers.

notes.text: Putting a sticker on someone else’s property will render the owner of that property mildly annoyed with the sticker and make them want to remove it (which is easy to do) once they discover it.

Touch one of these stickers that has been in place for at least a Mid Duration to teleport to another of these stickers that has also been in place for at least a Mid Duration, removing both in the process.

children.text: This can only be used if the owner and both targeted stickers are all completely concealed from everyone.

name: INFILTRATOR
quote: “O divine art of subtlety and secrecy! Through you we learn to be invisible, and hence we can hold the enemy’s fate in our hands.”
overview: You are an unseen interloper, slipping into impenetrable strongholds to assist your team from the inside. You have endless gadgets and substantial plot control, but take care not to get caught — you have paper-thin defenses and few options in a fair fight.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to ensure you can work behind the scenes. A classic break-in style scenario isn’t necessary, you can thrive in all kinds of situations so long as you have room to breathe, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try upping the time pressure.
grounding: Grounded in tropes surrounding heists, covert operations, and the pragmatic side of spycraft.
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Infiltrator besides Reflex and Intelligence? Consider Sensory, Luck, or Skill.
Be extra careful to avoid out-of-character communication while playing this class.
“While off on your own, remember to communicate frequently with your team.” — Tim M.

abilities.name: Identity Theft
abilities.description: Perfectly disguise yourself as a target you have neutralized, absorbing some of their knowledge in the process.
abilities.paired_action: Kill, knock out, or otherwise get rid of the target while taking an object from them.

notes.text: This disguise can be extremely convincing, extending to voice, outfit, and similar, scaling on how important and/or emblematic the object taken from the target is.

While disguised, you may ask your Conduit up to three questions about basic information the target would have known. (e.g. “What’s the password?”, “What’s the next item on their schedule?”, “Where is the boss’s office located?”)
If news of the target’s discovery (dead or alive) reaches the user’s location or the user loses possession of the object they took from the target, Identity Theft will end prematurely.

abilities.name: Case the Joint
abilities.description: Develop a mental map of a structure or location.
abilities.paired_action: Closely observe the location for a Low Duration, then close your eyes to activate.

notes.text: Gives the user a 3D view of the location’s layout, which they may examine at will while their eyes are closed.

While the user is examining their mental map, you may ask your Conduit up to four questions about the location, anything that a regular inhabitant of it might be privy to. (e.g. “When is the next shift change for the guards?”, “Are there any deliveries scheduled for today?”, “Is there a security camera covering the back door?”)
No Duration, and Cooldown begins on use rather than on expiry, though reusing the Ability will end the current instance.

abilities.name: Maximum Security
abilities.description: Pitch coming across both a valuable prize and the formidable security measures guarding it.
abilities.paired_action: Narrowly avoid being detected, caught, or similar by the defenses as part of the initiating Pitch.

notes.text: Cooldown scales on the Impact of the Pitched prize (as relevant to the user and their mission), which must in turn be proportional to the apparent challenge posed by the Pitched defenses. (e.g. A sleepy watchman posted at a side entrance would have a Low Cooldown; a sophisticated retinal scan gating access to top secret files would have a Mid Cooldown; a deadly monster guarding a sacred relic would have a High Cooldown.)

children.text: You may choose to leave some elements of your Pitch ambiguous, the Conduit filling in as they see fit.

gear.name: Earpiece
gear.description: Small, sound-isolating communicator tucked in an ear.

notes.text: Includes an identical copy, given out before or during the mission; the two wearers may speak to each other at any Range.
Harder to detect while worn and makes any words spoken into one by its wearer harder to detect as well.

gear.name: Catsuit
gear.description: Skintight bodysuit that may be worn discreetly under other clothing or gear.

notes.text: Provides a notable Boost to flexibility and causes the owner to leave substantially fewer traces of their passage, such as stray hairs, footprints, or similar.
While not wearing bulky clothing or body armor alongside this suit, all of the owner’s actions are dramatically quieted.

gear.name: Stiletto
gear.description: Knife with a long, slender blade.

notes.text: Killing an enemy with this knife without being noticed by other non-allies renders the owner much harder to detect for a Low Duration.

gear.name: Time Bombs
gear.description: Dinner plate-sized ordnances. Ominously beep once armed; disarmed if heavily damaged.

notes.text: Affixable to any flat surface; slightly harder to see when placed.

When placing, choose a Duration from Low to High; explodes once the chosen Duration elapses, with power scaling accordingly up to beyond High. (e.g. A Low Duration would wreck an armored car; a Mid Duration would breach a bank vault; a High Duration would bring down a skyscraper.)

gear.name: Skeleton Key
gear.description: Antique key, oversized for most actual locks.

notes.text: Smoothly transforms to fit any lock.

children.text: For analog locks without a keyhole (keypad, rotary, etc.), instead transforms into a specialty tool to open it; this takes a few seconds for simple devices, scaling up to a Low Duration for more complex ones.

notes.text: When placed against a technological or magical security feature, this key gradually works to bypass that feature over a Low Duration.

gear.name: Listening Bugs
gear.description: Tiny audio recording devices. Come with a handheld receiver, kept on the owner’s person.

notes.text: Affixable to any solid surface; slightly harder to detect when placed.
A bug must be recovered to play back recorded audio; receiver may be used to listen in live.
Casual physical contact lets the owner teleport a bug from their person anywhere onto that target’s body.

name: SAMARITAN
quote: “Not what I Have but what I Do is my Kingdom.”
overview: You are a chronic do-gooder with a saintly reputation gained through acts of charity. You’re little help during a fight but are indispensable once the dust has cleared, healing the wounded, feeding the sick, and drawing attention to the cause to elicit aid from others.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should not shy away from combat; you are uncommonly contributive even when far from the action, making split parties much less of a concern. Your playstyle, however, is profoundly social, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try creating NPCs who are less sympathetic and cooperative.
grounding: Grounded in charity medicine, fundraising, and adjacent tropes of indiscriminate humanitarianism.
examples_heading: Examples from history and pop culture include:
examples: Clara Barton, Florence Nightingale, and other historical on-the-ground altruists
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Samaritan besides Vitality and Spirit? Consider Will, Resilience, or Vigor.
Consider the ordering of your powers: some of them have prerequisites that are countered by the effects of others.
“Be sure you’re comfortable with character acting before playing this Class.” — Tintenseher

abilities.name: Gifts in Kind
abilities.description: Inspire generosity in a target or group of any size to elicit a gift from them, which you may then teleport to any being you know genuinely needs it.
abilities.paired_action: Politely and persuasively request the desired gift, making clear that doing so is voluntary.

notes.text: Inspired generosity has up to High Impact, scaling on the effectiveness of the Paired Action.
Recipients of Teleported gifts will instinctively know who and where they came from.
If the user makes use of any of these gifts themselves rather than distributing them to others (via Teleporting or otherwise), this Ability’s Cooldown is increased to High.

abilities.name: Thoughts & Prayers
abilities.description: Bring public attention to a single target’s plight to convert others’ concern for them into gradual rejuvenation.
abilities.paired_action: Compellingly broadcast the target’s predicament to as many bystanders as possible.

notes.text: Rejuvenation is determined via Pitch and may include healing, restoring Stamina or Essence, repairing possessions, and more, scaling Low–High on how many bystanders the user involves and the depths of their concern. Essence Cost scales similarly.
May affect up to a small group with a shared predicament, but the user must involve a much larger group of bystanders.

abilities.name: Extol Virtue
abilities.description: Laud a positive trait or behavior in a target to redouble their commitment towards it and restore their Essence.
abilities.paired_action: Publicly praise the target at length, focusing on a specific virtue they clearly have or are observably demonstrating.

notes.text: Impact and Duration both scale on how positively affected the target is by the user’s praise.
Only successful when used on a trait or behavior that both the user and the target consider a virtue.

children.text: Bystanders who witness the Paired Action and who also see the trait or behavior as a virtue become more likely to respect and approve of the target (scaling as above).

notes.text: Any other player (or the Conduit, in the case of an NPC) may, with your permission, have their character use this Ability on your character (spending their Essence). The other character must be sincere in their praise.

gear.name: Habit
gear.description: Traditional monastic uniform.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against hostile magics.

children.text: If the owner causes harm to another being, this Ward is disabled for a Mid Duration.

notes.text: A truly selfless act to a non-ally will restore L–H the owner’s Essence, scaling on the effort they put into this act (Mid Cooldown).

gear.name: Asklepian
gear.description: Large wand entwined with a stylized serpent.

notes.text: Gently touch another being with this wand to gradually heal them over up to a Low Duration (Low Cooldown). This has a Low–High Essence Cost, scaling on the Impact of this healing.

children.text: If the owner causes harm to another being, this wand is disabled in full for a High Duration, and all its recent healing is undone.

gear.name: Alms
gear.description: Low-denomination coins.

notes.text: Giving a single one of these coins to a grateful recipient will conjure some mundane provisions for them (such as food, clothing, money, or medicine) appropriate to the locale, determined via Pitch.

gear.name: Wings of Mercy
gear.description: Dainty shoulderpiece in the form of a pair of wings.

notes.text: While actively moving to rescue a wounded or imperiled target, this shoulderpiece produces angelic wings of light that enable the owner to fly slightly faster than their normal running pace (Low Duration, Mid Cooldown).

children.text: If the owner hears such a target call for help, the effect’s Cooldown is bypassed; if already off of Cooldown, its Duration increases to Mid.

gear.name: Innocence Shield
gear.description: Ceremonial shield, about the size of a dinnerplate, so flimsy as to be almost unusable for actual defense.

notes.text: While used to protect nonaggressive beings, this shield glows and gains Boosted size and defense, scaling dramatically on the number and vulnerability of those being defended, beyond High at maximum. (e.g. Protecting one person would make it about as large and effective as a standard heater shield; protecting a large group would make it about as large as a gatehouse and as tough as a military-grade blast door.)

children.text: Increased size comes without any penalties to weight or usability for the owner (even when gigantic).

gear.name: Guiding Light
gear.description: Handheld oil lantern, magically lit at will.

notes.text: While lit with good intent, this lantern gently compels the fearful, lost, or hopeless to approach its light.

children.text: When held aloft, this light also becomes visible to all non-enemies, even through physical obstacles.

name: VESSEL
quote: “The battleline between good and evil cuts through the heart of every man.”
overview: You are an unassuming host to a baleful supernatural entity, which occasionally escapes to sow chaos and reap destruction. While normally your playstyle is social and supportive, you can become a devastating magical threat to everyone (including your allies) at a moment’s notice.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should try to give you plenty of strong emotional hooks in their plot and NPCs, which you will need to unlock the full potential of your kit. You tend to function best when given time to build investment and set up future plays, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try increasing the mission’s time pressure.
grounding: Grounded in the trope of evil sealed within an innocent, particularly pervasive across modern fantasy media.
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Vessel besides Spirit and Will? Consider Arcane, Luck, or Resilience.
This is a complicated Class: be sure you understand Turning Points, Altered States, Defiance, & Manifestation before playing it.
“Friendly fire is a real danger with Embrace the Darkness: Fill the Void can only spare one person.” — Kadrien

abilities.name: Insidious Whispers
abilities.description: Learn a major secret about another person, exaggerating your own worst personal flaws in the process. This secret may only be shared privately, also exaggerating the flaws of whoever it is shared with.
abilities.paired_action: Pause ominously as you hear your entity's eerie voice whispering into your mind.

notes.text: The secret is learned from your character's entity, voiced by the Conduit, as grounded in your character’s Backstory.
Flaw exaggeration for the user and those they share the secret with scales Low–Mid on the secret's importance.

Any other player whose character the user is closely interacting with (or the Conduit, in the case of an NPC) may, with your permission, activate this Ability themselves (spending their Essence). They and anyone they share the secret with have their personal flaws exaggerated as normal.

abilities.name: Embrace the Darkness
abilities.description: Become possessed by the dangerous entity within you, dramatically Boosting the power of your aggressive Manifestations.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of being overwhelmed by negative emotions (fear, hatred, or similar), proceeding then to act indiscriminately malicious and destructive to everyone around (ally or enemy) as a potent Altered State.

notes.text: Impact scales on how compellingly you portray the Paired Action and Altered State, beyond High at max.

children.text: Specific behavior in this state should be informed by the nature of the entity within them, as grounded in their Backstory.

notes.text: Boosted Manifestations must be directly thematically linked to the user’s entity, as grounded in their Backstory, and can be used more often than normal without incurring a Limiter from the Conduit.

abilities.name: Fill the Void
abilities.description: Spare a single person from yourself, protecting them with a shadowy barrier.
abilities.paired_action: Portray a Turning Point of genuine gratitude, appreciation, or similar for your target.

notes.text: The target becomes completely immune to all harm and negative effects sourced from the user (Abilities, physical actions, or anything else).

children.text: Preexisting harm and negative effects are not affected.

notes.text: While the target is interacting with the user in an uplifting manner, the user’s Defiance is Boosted.
Cooldown begins on use rather than on expiry, though reusing the Ability will end the current instance.

children.text: Outside of an Altered State, if the user ever feels rejected or betrayed by the target, this Ability will end prematurely.

gear.name: Ceremonial Raiment
gear.description: Simple gown worn by the subject of a ritual.

notes.text: Religious or spiritual individuals will tend to trust the owner, with Impact scaling up to High on how much the owner thematically reflects that individual’s faith (through their Appearance, actions, and similar).

Predisposes individual bystanders to come to the owner’s aid or defense if the owner appears to be beleaguered or imperiled, scaling Low–Mid on how sympathetic and/or appealing the owner is to that individual.

gear.name: Ritual Knife
gear.description: Ornamental blade, very sharp but delicate.

notes.text: When fittingly incorporated into the Paired Action of a sacrifice (for Energywork, Manifestation, or similar), Boosts the potency of the resulting magic.

gear.name: Altar Lights
gear.description: Consecrated candles, magically lit at will.

notes.text: While lit, gradually weakens and eats away at hostile magics within a Low Range.

gear.name: Deathmask
gear.description: Eerie mask, meant for the dead.

notes.text: While worn, gradually causes fear and discomfort in non-agents towards discomfort and fear over a Low Duration while they remain in the owner’s immediate presence.
This mask will gradually afflict any wearer with a crippling illness over a High Duration. This fades at the same rate once the mask is taken off.

children.text: If the owner incurs this illness, they may also inflict it upon any being they touch who is fully affected by the above fear and discomfort.

gear.name: Shadow Blade
gear.description: Streak of dark, eerie magical energy that badly burns others on contact, materializing around the owner’s hand as though it were a continuation of their arm.

notes.text: May only materialize during a successful Turning Point involving the owner, sharing the Duration of its associated effect (Low if none listed).

children.text: Essence Cost is paid upon materialization.

notes.text: Incorporeally bypasses armor. Successful strikes deplete a target’s Essence, rather than physically harming them, in proportion to the damage the strike would normally have inflicted.

children.text: Courage, virtue, and strength of character protect against such blows rather than physical toughness.

gear.name: Star Crystal
gear.description: Radiant gem.

notes.text: Any being may calmly hold out this crystal uninterrupted for a Low Duration to imbibe it, healing them and restoring a full Essence Threshold. The crystal is expended in the process.

children.text: The crystal will glow brilliantly as it is being imbibed. Anyone who sees this (besides the source character) is instantly inclined towards deeply coveting the crystal.

name: WITCHFINDER
quote: "Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.”
overview: You are a shadowy persecutor on the hunt for magical evildoers, wielding accusations, prejudice, and fear as proficiently as any weapon. While generally specialized against spellcasters, your skillset is very broad, though your teammates may find you difficult or distasteful to work with.
conduit_notes: Conduits designing a mission for you should give you some magic to interact with, though impressionable bystanders can be even more important. Your game plan is largely social at its core, so if the Conduit wants to really challenge you they could try making smarter NPCs who are harder to scare and manipulate.
grounding: Grounded in witch-hunting traditions and tales from all around the world and the modern media they have inspired.
examples_heading: Examples from history & pop culture include:
examples: Matthew Hopkins, Heinrich Kramer, Reverend John Hale, and other historical anti-witch agitators
tips: Stuck on what stats to give your Witchfinder besides Will and Sensory? Consider Spirit, Reflex, or Skill.
Look for ways to manipulate NPCs into cooperating with you.
“Though rarely friendly, you still need to play social. You can't gather information, stir up unrest, and get others to conspire with you if you aren't out there talking to people.” — Rich D.

abilities.name: Cloud of Suspicion
abilities.description: Create a dark, obscuring mist that steadily fills your surroundings, gradually predisposing all within towards fear and mistrust.
abilities.paired_action: Make an ominous speech to a group of listeners lasting up to a Low Duration.

notes.text: Duration, Range, and maximum Impact all scale on the length of the user’s Paired Action.
This mist will not appear to be sourced from the user, arriving instead like a sudden weather phenomenon.
Upon expiry, this mist and its associated fear and mistrust will dissipate at the same rate it arrived.

abilities.name: Omoriori
abilities.description: Learn from your Conduit the direction and intensity of a chosen type of magic or negative emotion.
abilities.paired_action: Specify what you are sensing for, then deeply inhale.

notes.text: The chosen type of magic/emotion should be succinct and straightforward. (e.g. “Fire Magic”, “Religious Magic”, “Rune Magic”; “Hatred”, “Greed”, “Jealousy”.)

children.text: Sources of the chosen magic/emotion already known to the user are exempted unless specified otherwise.

notes.text: Alternatively, closely examining clear evidence of an unknown magic while inhaling will identify that magic’s type (as above) instead of this Ability’s normal effects.

abilities.name: Malleus Maleficarum
abilities.description: Redirect a hostile magic towards yourself while delivering an empowered strike against it or its source.
abilities.paired_action: Shout a zealous proclamation while brandishing a weapon.

notes.text: Empowered strike Impact scales Low–High on the potency of the magic this Ability is redirecting.

children.text: This empowered strike may target the redirected magic itself as though it were a physical object, negating it outright if the strike is of substantial Impact.
If the magic’s source is hit by the empowered strike, they are prevented outright from using that magic again.

notes.text: Innate supernatural capacities or notably longstanding or widespread spells cannot be affected by this Ability.

gear.name: Capotain
gear.description: Tall hat with a broad brim.

notes.text: Predisposes any being approached subtly and privately towards conspiring with the owner.

children.text: The owner will instinctively become aware if such a conspirator ever double-crosses them.

gear.name: Watchcoat
gear.description: Very heavy coat with shoulder-to-ankle coverage.

notes.text: Provides a Mid Ward against both weather and ambient magics.
Lurking in shadowy surroundings will gradually render the owner harder to detect over a Low Duration, scaling Low–Mid on how slowly they are moving.

gear.name: Ballestrino
gear.description: Miniature crossbow worn on the back of the hand, easily reloaded with a twist of the wrist.

notes.text: This crossbow is harder to detect until the moment it is aimed at a target (Mid Cooldown).

When removed from an eye, that eye gains greater acuity and can see through up to a Low combined depth of chosen solid objects, both scaling on how long it had fully covered that eye before being removed.

children.text: The eye incurs damage as it remains uncovered, becoming unusable after a Mid Duration.

gear.name: Firebrand
gear.description: Metal rod whose tip may be superheated at will, causing great pain but only minor damage.

notes.text: Those burned by this rod are strongly inclined towards rage, which lasts for up to a Low Duration scaling on how long it burned them for (up to several seconds).

children.text: If the heated rod is brandished while the owner speaks rousingly, listeners are inclined towards a lesser but longer-lasting anger, scaling Low–Mid on how long they listen (up to a Low Duration).

gear.name: Aspergillum
gear.description: Consecrated one-handed mace with a spiked head.

notes.text: This mace is infused with holy power when striking beings the owner compellingly deems as evil, scaling on how evil the owner believes them to be.

children.text: Speak a sacred verse while swinging this mace to spray holy water from it, which scalds and briefly weakens those deemed evil, scaling as above (Mid Cooldown).
